edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against governance to authorize the pendingGovernance write.
msg.sender is compared against pendingGovernance to authorize the governance transfer.
Constructor initializes governance with the deployer msg.sender.
add() gates pair registration on msg.sender == governance.
keeper modifier checks KP4R.isKeeper(msg.sender) before running the guarded body.
upkeep modifier checks KP4R.isKeeper(msg.sender) and later rewards msg.sender.
workable(address) compares block.timestamp against the stored observation timestamp (timestamp dependency).
_update derives timeElapsed from block.timestamp and decides whether to commit an observation.
_valid compares block.timestamp against the last observation timestamp to detect stale prices.
current() uses block.timestamp for elapsed time and observation rollback logic.
add() writes Observation(block.timestamp, ...) into pairObservations.
quote() relies on observation timestamps and staleness windows tied to block time.
keeper modifier reads the KP4R registry constant to verify authorization.
upkeep modifier calls into the external KP4R registry for both checks and rewards.
KP4R.worked(msg.sender) is an external callback executed at the end of the upkeep modifier body.
KP4R.isKeeper(msg.sender) is an external call made before the guarded function body executes.
The upkeep modifier wraps work(), so the reward callback runs after _updateAll state changes.
keeper modifier guards updatePair().
keeper modifier guards update(), which reaches the external calls inside _update.
keeper modifier guards workForFree().
keeper modifier guards updateFor().
setGovernance writes the caller-supplied _governance into pendingGovernance.
The pendingGovernance write is the privileged state change executed inside setGovernance.
acceptGovernance promotes pendingGovernance into the governance state variable.
The governance = pendingGovernance write is performed inside acceptGovernance.
Constructor writes the initial governance value.
updatePair forwards execution into the internal _update routine which performs external calls.
update resolves the pair then forwards execution into _update's external call path.
updateFor loops over _pairs and invokes _update for each entry.
work() calls _updateAll() to refresh every registered pair.
workForFree() calls _updateAll() to refresh every registered pair.
_updateAll iterates _pairs and calls the external-call-bearing _update for each pair.
The external oracle/price read inside _update occurs before the observation state write.
_update computes timeElapsed = block.timestamp - lastObservation(pair).timestamp as an unchecked subtraction.
_update pushes a new Observation into pairObservations[pair].
add() pushes the initial Observation into pairObservations[pair].
add() marks the derived pair as known in the _known mapping.
add() appends the derived pair to the _pairs array.
The governance-gated registry mutations are the state writes performed inside add().
add() reads the factory constant to derive the pair address.
update() reads the factory constant to derive the pair address.
current() reads the factory constant to derive the pair address.
quote() reads the factory constant to derive the pair address.
workable() loops over _pairs calling the per-pair workable(address) check.
workable(address) reads the last observation timestamp to compare against block time.
workable(address) compares the elapsed time against the periodSize constant.
_valid reads the last observation of the pair to bound its age.
current() loads the last Observation of the pair for its computation.
current() calls computeAmountOut with the derived cumulative prices and elapsed time.
quote() calls computeAmountOut once per observation interval in its loop.
computeAmountOut divides the cumulative price delta by the supplied timeElapsed.
quote() derives its loop bounds from length.sub(granularity), which depends on caller-controlled granularity.
current() enforces freshness through _valid(pair, periodSize.mul(2)) before quoting.
current() reads pairObservations[pair] to fetch observation history.
quote() reads pairObservations[pair] across its iteration range.
lastObservation() indexes pairObservations[pair] at its final element.

normalization_plan.reason: _governance only feeds the pendingGovernance assignment inside setGovernance and has no standalone semantic identity.
The pair argument is only an argument forwarded to _update by updatePair.
tokenA only participates in the pairFor derivation inside update.
tokenB only participates in the pairFor derivation inside update.
tokenIn is only used for pairFor/sortTokens inside current.
The amount in is only consumed by computeAmountOut from the current function body.
tokenOut is only used for pairFor/sortTokens inside current.
granularity only drives the staleness window and the loop bounds inside quote.
This parameter is a direct operand of the cumulative price delta computed in computeAmountOut.
This parameter is a direct operand of the cumulative price delta computed in computeAmountOut.
This parameter is the divisor in computeAmountOut's price average computation.
age is only compared against the observation age inside _valid.
i is only the loop start index of updateFor.
length is only the loop bound of updateFor.
The accumulator exists solely to produce the boolean returned by _updateAll.
The elapsed-time local is only used for the periodSize comparison inside _update.
nextIndex is a loop look-ahead temporary used only inside quote.
The accumulator local is only used inside quote before being divided by granularity.
The Observation copy is a transient value used only inside current.
The boolean local only captures the _updateAll return value for the require in work.
